product_one_liner.value: Lumilens builds pluggable, near-package, and co-packaged optical interconnects that help hyperscalers scale AI data-center GPU clusters across scale-out and scale-up architectures.
product_one_liner.notes: The product page describes its optical interconnect portfolio and its hyperscaler AI-compute use.

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer have no pricing link, and no public pricing page was found.

named_customers.notes: The company describes a multi-billion-dollar customer agreement but does not identify the customer by name; no two named customers appear in the cited disclosure.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn explicitly gives the company-size band as 201–500; a separate profile feed lists 164 people, so the stated band is used with that discrepancy noted.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn lists headquarters in San Jose, California, United States.

founded_year.notes: LinkedIn lists Lumilens as founded in 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The index shows one Blog article, “Networks Are Now the AI Bottleneck”; the adjacent “Why We Founded Lumilens” item is a video, not a second engineering post.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer link to product, company, news, careers, blog, privacy, and terms pages, but not to public product documentation, a help center, or a developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers board is open, but no AI/ML/data-science-titled vacancy was found; accessible data-related postings are titled Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Data and Analytics Engineer, which the criteria exclude. The Machine Learning Engineer reference on the culture page is an employee profile, not a vacancy.

model_provider.notes: No public model or model provider was found in the product, privacy/security, or blog materials reviewed; Lumilens’s described product is photonic interconnect hardware.

compliance_certs.notes: Lumilens’s public privacy/legal page does not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a certification.

last_funding.notes: The company disclosed more than $700 million in its latest financing on August 6, 2026; the exact amount was not stated, so the numeric amount is the disclosed $700 million floor.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 6, 2026 financing announcement is within the 18 months before November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live Ashby posting is titled Customer Sales Representative, a sales-representative title; its description emphasizes customer/post-sales work, so the title is broader than a specifically named SDR, BDR, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: On August 6, 2026, Lumilens announced its emergence from stealth and said it was commercially shipping its first product, within the six months before November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Neera Patel’s LinkedIn profile lists her Lumilens CFO role as starting in October 2026, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Salesforce is named as a CRM in a Lumilens Business Process Manager posting; HubSpot appears among the listed skills on a Lumilens Assistant Office Manager posting.
